articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Tonix Pharmaceuticals Announces Presentation of Phase 1 Data and Plans for an Adaptive Phase 2 Field Study of TNX-4800 (anti-Borrelia OspA monoclonal antibody) for the Prevention of Lyme Disease at the 4th Annual Ticks and Tickborne Diseases Symposium at Johns Hopkins University. Company on track to initiate a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, adaptive Phase 2 field study in the first half of 2027, pending FDA agreement Phase 2 field study expected to test a two-dose regimen of TNX-4800 subcutaneous with an initial Spring dose followed by a Summer booster two months later; the primary endpoint is Lyme disease prevention for six months TNX-4800 is expected to provide protection against Lyme disease within two days of the first dose for the peak of the U.S. Lym Related tickers mentioned: TNXP.
